limits: Synthetic two-vCPU fixture only; no production or browser latency measurement.
No material CPU improvement established on the three principal routes; admin timings vary and baseline ran first.
Explicit lstat counter does not include filesystem operations internal to realpathSync/readFileSync.
Existing pathname stat-to-read race remains; no descriptor-level race protection is claimed.
Three conditional routes are unmounted HTTP404 diagnostics, excluded from timing evidence.
Raw reports and logs retained privately; public records are sanitized summaries and hash bindings.
